name: PM-KISAN
desc: Central income support paid in three instalments, subject to scheme rules and exclusions.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Mandal Agriculture Officer / authorised PM-KISAN or CSC helpdesk
steps: Read eligibility and exclusions on the official portal.
Use Farmers Corner for the authorised registration, e-KYC or status service.
Ask the Agriculture Office to resolve incorrect beneficiary or land records.
amountNote: AP Annadata Sukhibhava may describe a combined Centre/state amount. Do not count the PM-KISAN component twice.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Crop insurance for notified crops and seasons
desc: Insurance enrolment, premium calculation and policy-status services are available through the official PMFBY portal.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Mandal Agriculture Officer / participating bank / insurer; PMFBY helpline 14447
steps: Confirm whether your crop, location and season are notified.
Check the deadline, premium and documents with the authorised channel.
Use the official portal or participating bank/CSC to enrol and keep your policy receipt.
amountNote: Insurance is not automatic for every crop. Follow the applicable loss-reporting deadlines in the policy.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
desc: KCC is a credit facility. The lending bank decides eligibility, limit, interest terms and required documents.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Your participating bank branch / cooperative bank or PACS
steps: Ask the branch for the current KCC application and eligibility rules.
Submit the required farming or allied-activity records through the bank.
Read repayment, interest and security terms before accepting the loan.
amountNote: A loan is repayable credit, not a cash grant. The Kisan Rin Portal includes institutional workflows; farmers should contact their bank for applications.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: Soil Health Card
desc: A field-specific soil report helps farmers understand nutrient status and recommended soil/fertiliser management.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Mandal / District Agriculture Officer or approved soil-testing laboratory
steps: Ask the Agriculture Office about sample collection and local coverage.
Use the prescribed sampling process and keep the sample reference.
Review the resulting card with the Agriculture Officer before changing inputs.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: e-NAM
desc: The national agricultural market platform supports farmer registration, trading information and market-linked services.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Nearest participating APMC / e-NAM mandi registration desk
steps: Confirm that your nearby market and commodity participate.
Register through the official portal, app or mandi desk.
Ask the mandi about assaying, bidding, payment and delivery procedures.
amountNote: Registration does not guarantee a buyer, a particular sale price or immediate sale.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: PM-KUSUM
desc: Central support is implemented through designated state agencies for the approved solar-pump and solar-generation components.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
steps: Check the applicable component and current state notification.
Confirm subsidy, beneficiary contribution and approved vendor details with the state agency.
Apply only through the authorised state route.
amountNote: The contribution, subsidy and application window differ by component and state. Do not pay a vendor based only on a general scheme summary.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Support for eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople
desc: The programme supports eligible self-employed workers in specified traditional trades, subject to its family and other eligibility rules.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Authorised CSC / District Industries or implementing office
steps: Check whether your trade and household meet the scheme rules.
Visit an authorised CSC for the prescribed registration process.
Follow local verification and the authorised benefit/training stages.
amountNote: Farming alone does not establish eligibility: the specified artisan trade and other scheme conditions apply.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: National Scholarship Portal
desc: Students can view scholarships, complete the required One Time Registration and use the official application/status services.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: School / college scholarship nodal officer or authorised CSC
steps: Choose the specific scholarship matching your course and category.
Read its current deadline and eligibility, then complete the required OTR.
Apply on NSP and follow institute/department verification.
amountNote: NSP contains multiple scholarship schemes; eligibility, amounts and deadlines differ. It is not one universal scholarship payment.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: PMAY–Urban 2.0
benefit: Housing assistance for eligible urban households
desc: The official programme describes assistance through different housing components, subject to household and jurisdiction rules.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Municipal housing section / designated PMAY-U office
steps: Confirm that your address falls under the urban programme.
Ask the municipal housing office which component and application route apply.
Check household housing ownership and previous-benefit exclusions.
amountNote: Rural residents need the appropriate rural housing programme instead. Do not assume urban assistance applies to every village.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Eligibility-based access to covered hospital treatment
desc: Beneficiary eligibility and covered treatment must be checked through authorised PM-JAY and state health-scheme channels.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Ayushman helpdesk / Aarogyamithra desk at an empanelled hospital
steps: Ask an authorised hospital helpdesk to verify beneficiary eligibility.
Confirm that the hospital and treatment package are covered before admission.
Use the official grievance route for coverage or billing problems.
amountNote: Coverage is not an unrestricted cash payment. State integration and the patient category affect the applicable process.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.

name: PMAY–Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefit: Housing assistance for eligible rural households
desc: Rural housing support for eligible houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated homes, subject to survey lists, exclusions and local verification.
status: Official programme; local availability must be confirmed
contact: Gram Panchayat / Village Secretariat housing assistant / MPDO or block rural-development office
steps: Ask the Gram Panchayat or housing office whether your household appears on the verified survey or waiting list.
Check current exclusions, survey/correction opportunities and Gram Sabha verification with the authorised office.
Follow the official sanction process and keep the acknowledgement. A website eligibility check alone does not guarantee a house.
amountNote: This is the rural programme. PMAY–Urban 2.0 has different jurisdiction and eligibility rules. Confirm current assistance and any state contribution with the housing office.
docs: Check the scheme-specific document list on the official website.
Provide identity, land, education or bank records only through the authorised application channel.
